findings: The book's degeneracy example says AUG, GUG, UUG and CUG all code for methionine; in the standard code only AUG does (GUG, UUG and CUG can serve as start codons in some bacteria). The lesson corrects this in a note and gives leucine's six codons as an example, flagged.
The book's Analyse and Interpret question is printed without an answer; the lesson's answer was derived for it and needs the second-person review.
